αἰνὰ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. pl.
αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ, αἲ γάρ)
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg., Ionic and Attic alike (the η follows σ); κακῇ αἴσῃ ’by an evil fate’
αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, destiny; fem. nom. sg., used impersonally with an inf.: ’it is not his lot to…’ · also plain subject: ’portion, lot’ (ἅσσα οἱ αἶσα … νήσαντο ’whatever his portion … spun for him’)
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also masc. gen. pl., ’their own’ with no possessive expressed (αὐτῶν κτήματα ’their own possessions’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun, depending on the adverb σχεδόθεν: ’near them’
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.
βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. with εἴκων, the thing yielded to: ’yielding to force’ (βίῃ καὶ κάρτεϊ εἴκων) · also dat. of respect, ’in strength’ (βίῃ φέρτερος ’stronger in strength’)
βαῖνον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαινον)
βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν): ’went’
δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέξατο)
δήν: δήν — for a long time; adv.
δίπτυχα: δίπτυχος — twofold, double-folded; neut. acc. pl., predicative with ποιέω (δίπτυχα ποιήσαντες ’folding (it) double’)
δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’ · also gen. after δεύομαι ’lack’: ’lacking the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης) · also gen. sg. depending on a noun: ’of the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἀνίην ’the vexation of the feast’) · also gen. sg. after ὄνησο (ὀνίνημι mid.): δαιτὸς ὄνησο ’have enjoyment of the feast’ · also gen. sg. after ἀμέρδεαι: ’deprived of the feast’
δεξιτερῇ: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιᾷ)
δεπάεσσιν: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
διαπρήσσουσα: διαπράσσω — accomplish, make one’s way through; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., with κέλευθον: ’covering her course’
διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg. · also δίδωμι ’give’: aor. subj. 1 sg., ’I may give’ (ἵνα τοι δῶ ’that I may give you’)
εἶμ: εἶμι — go, shall go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense, elided (εἶμ’ = εἶμι)
εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed, lair, resting-place; fem. acc. pl.
εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — epithet of Zeus, literal sense disputed (’wide-voiced’ or ’far-seeing’); masc. nom. sg. in short -α
εὔξαντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray; impf. 3 sg. (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-) · also declare, claim; impf. 3 sg. + inf.: ’he claimed (to be)’
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’made’ (ἀνάπυστα θέσαν ’made known’)
θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
κέλευθον: κέλευθος — way, path, journey; fem. acc. sg.
κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject (κήδε’ … τετεύχαται ’sorrows have been made ready’)
κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’a fine thing (to hear)’
κατά: κατά — down, down from, throughout; prep. + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented, in tmesis (κατά … ἔδυ = κατέδυ): ’went down into’ · also without tmesis, of the sun: ’set, went down’ (ἠέλιος κατέδυ)
κνέφας: κνέφας — dusk, darkness, nightfall; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κνίσῃ: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — fat enveloping the entrails, savour of burning fat; fem. dat. sg.
κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
κορυφῇ: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. sg.
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’young men!’ (κοῦροι ἐμοὶ μνηστῆρες)
κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); acc. pl.
κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’forgot’
λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα) · also λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (λίπ’ = λίπε): ’leave (me)’
λευκὰ: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. pl.
λεῖβε: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’poured’
μένων: μένω — remain, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun after a preposition: ’the middle’ (ἐς μέσον ’into the middle’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a person: ‘in the middle’ (σε μέσον βάλον ‘I would have struck you in the middle’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κενεῶνα: ’the middle of the flank’ (μέσον κενεῶνα)
μίνυνθά: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv., epic
μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they cut into small pieces’
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’with long (steps)’ (μακρὰ βιβάς ’striding with long steps’)
μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’ · also ’greatly, very’, strengthening ἤλιθα (μεγάλ’ ἤλιθα ’in huge abundance’)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
μολπῇ: μολπή — song with dance, play, merry-making; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μολπῇ): ’with song and dance’
νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ‘young men!’ (νέοι, ἐκπέμψασθε ‘young men, send out’)
νηός: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic (= Attic νεώς)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νώμησαν: νωμάω — deal out, distribute, wield; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνώμησαν)
οὐλοχύτας: οὐλοχύται — barley scattered on a sacrificial victim (οὐλαί + χέω ’pour’); fem. acc. pl.
οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg. · also a different word, neut. ’furrow-stretch’, the length a pair of mules ploughs in one go (οὖρον … ἡμιόνοιιν); exact measure unknown · also a different word, οὖρος — warden, guardian (related to ὁράω ’see, watch’); masc. acc. sg. (οὐ … οὖρον … κατέλειπον ’I left no warden behind’)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’) · also bare adv. after ἠέ ’than’, with no verb: ’before, formerly’ (μείζονα … ἠὲ πάρος ’taller than before’) · also with the article, adverbial: τὸ πάρος ’as before, formerly’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος ’as before’)
πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they tasted’
πάτερ: πατήρ — father; voc. sg. · also πατέρα, masc. acc. sg., elided (πάτερ’ = πατέρα): ’father’ (μητρὸς … πάτερ’ ’mother’s father’)
πέλασαν: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπέλασαν)
πέτασσαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπέτασαν)
πανημέριοι: πανημέριος — all day long; masc. nom. pl., used adjectivally where English has an adverb
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
παύσαντο: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαντο)
παῖδά: παῖς — child, son, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’ · also masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’son’ (παῖδά τε σὸν ’and your son’)
πεμπώβολα: πεμπώβολον — five-pronged fork/spit (Aeolic πέμπε ’five’ + ὀβελός ’spit’); neut. acc. pl.
περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)
πηλῆος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ποιήσαντες: ποιέω — make, do; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made’
πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg.
πολυβενθέος: πολυβενθής — very deep, many-fathomed (πολύς + βένθος); adj., fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with λιμένος (two-ending adj.)
ποντοπόροιο: ποντοπόρος — sea-going, crossing the sea; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νηός
πορφύρεον: πορφύρεος — dark-gleaming, surging, seething (of water, not a colour term here); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with κῦμα · also of a cloak, a colour term: ’purple, dark red’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος (πορφύρεον … φᾶρος ’a purple cloak’)
ποτοῖο: πότος — drink, drinking; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’with drink’
προβάλοντο: προβάλλω — throw forward, cast before; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they threw forward’
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προτόνοισιν: πρότονος — forestay (rope bracing the mast forward); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
πρυμνήσι: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl., elided (πρυμνήσι’ = πρυμνήσια)
πρυμνήσια: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl.
πωλέσκετο: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to haunt’
πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after ἄνευθε · also gen. after παύομαι ’cease from’: ’from toil’
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’) · also πόσις — husband; masc. gen. sg. (εὐνὴν … πόσιος ’her husband’s bed’)
σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
στείρῃ: στεῖρα — the ship’s stem, cutwater; dat. sg.
σχίζῃς: σχίζα — split wood, billet; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
τέκον: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔτεκον)
τέρπετ: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight, enjoy; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided τέρπετ’ (= ἐτέρπετο)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put!’ (πὰρ … τίθει ’set beside!’)
τερπικεραύνῳ: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
τετύκοντό: τεύχω — make, prepare; epic reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid. (with the accent of a following enclitic τε): ’they prepared’
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’ · also correlative with ὄφρα: ’so long’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἔην, τόφρα ’as long as she was alive, so long’)
τἆλλα: ἄλλος — other; τἆλλα, crasis of τὰ ἄλλα: the rest, the other things; neut. nom./acc. pl.
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, raise one’s voice; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
χαλκοβατὲς: χαλκοβατής — with a bronze threshold or floor (sense somewhat uncertain); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
χθιζὸς: χθιζός — of yesterday, yesterday’s; masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’yesterday’
ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’mounted’); acute kept before an enclitic
ἀνάγοντο: ἀνάγω — lead up; mid. put out to sea; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἀνήγοντο): ’they put to sea’
ἀνέλοντο: ἀναιρέω — take up, snatch up; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’took up’
ἀνασχών: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
ἀνεδύσετο: ἀναδύομαι — come up, emerge, rise up; aor. 3 sg., sigmatic thematic
ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg. (νόστος ἀπήμων ’a safe homecoming’)
ἀπεβήσετο: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -ήσετο (= ἀπέβη)
ἀπηύρων: ἀπαυράω — take away, deprive of; impf. 1 sg., epic (augmented ἀπ-ηύρων), + acc. of the thing taken
ἀτάρ: ἀτάρ — but, yet, and; conj., poetic (= αὐτάρ)
ἄμυνον: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’ward off!’
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄτερ: ἄτερ — without, apart from; prep. + gen.
ἐΐσης: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced, well-proportioned (of a ship; sense debated); fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἴσος) · also fem. gen. sg. agreeing with δαιτός: ’equal, fair-shared’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης)
ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’
ἐκάλυψαν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented κάλυψαν); in tmesis with κατά (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’)
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
ἐξέταμον: ἐκτάμνω — cut out; aor. 3 pl., epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ἐξέτεμον): ’they cut out’
ἐπαρξάμενοι: ἐπάρχω (mid. ἐπάρχομαι) — make a beginning of a rite, pour the first drops for a libation; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.
ἐρέουσα: ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. fem. nom. sg., epic open -έουσα (= Attic ἐροῦσα)
ἐρετμοῖς: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with oars’
ἐρύσαντό: ἐρύω — draw, drag; pull off a spit; aor. 3 pl. mid., accented before an enclitic
ἐσκίδναντο: σκεδάννυμι (epic pres. σκίδνημι) — scatter, disperse; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’scattered’
ἐφετμέων: ἐφετμή — command, injunction, behest; fem. gen. pl., rare epic noun
ἐφῆκεν: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon; aor. 3 sg., augmented
ἑκάεργος: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooter, epithet of Apollo (the first element is ἑκάς ’far’; the second is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having taken’
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, enlarged epic form ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ (πατρὸς ἑοῦ ’of his own father’)
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they threw down’ · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I threw down’
ἔδειραν: δέρω — flay; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they flayed’
ἔθεεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg.: ’was running, sped on’
ἔκλυες: κλύω — hear; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you heard’
ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (οἱ)
ἔπλετ: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπλετ’ = ἔπλετο): ’has come to be’
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
ἔρυσσαν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic doubled-σ (= Attic εἴρυσαν): ’they hauled’
ἔστησαν: ἵστημι — set up, stand; aor. 3 pl. of ἔστην, intransitive: ’took their stand, stood’
ἔσφαξαν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they slaughtered’
ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I nurtured, I fed’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they reared’ (μ’ ἔτρεφον αὐτοί ’they themselves reared me’)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’I had, I was carrying’
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
ἕρματα: ἕρμα — earring, pendant (also ’prop, support’); neut. acc. pl. ἕρματα
ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; nom. sg. · also Ἠέλιος, the Sun as a god, Helios: nom. sg.
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’ · also + gen. of the way: ἦρχε ὁδοῖο ’led the way’ · also absolute: ’ruled, was king’
ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἴκμενον: ἴκμενος — favorable, following (of a wind); masc. acc. sg., in the formula ἴκμενον οὖρον
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’used to go, come’ · also as a simple narrative past, ’went’ (μνηστῆρες … ἴσαν ’the suitors went’), not necessarily iterative · also οἶδα — know; unaugmented plup. 3 pl. with impf. sense, epic (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’they knew’ (τὰ δ’ οὐκ ἴσαν ’they did not know’)
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come upon, reach; impf./aor. 3 sg.
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
ὀϊζυρὸς: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; masc. nom. sg.
ὄφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; ὄφελες (= ὤφελες) aor. 2 sg., unaugmented, in a wish: ’would that you had’
ὅρμον: ὅρμος — necklace (from εἴρω ’string’); masc. acc. sg. · also ὅρμος — anchorage, roadstead (cf. ὁρμίζω ’bring to anchor’); masc. acc. sg.
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’) · also + gen., in an adjuration: ’by’ (ὑπὲρ θυέων καὶ δαίμονος ’by the sacrifices and a power’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
ὠκυπόροισι: ὠκυπόρος — swift-going, swift-sailing; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις; a two-ending adjective), agreeing with νέεσσιν
ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl.: ’they laid raw pieces’
ὤπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl., accented before an enclitic
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf.: ’to offer’ (ῥέξαι ἑκατόμβας ’to offer hecatombs’) · also aor. inf. ’to do’ (οὐδέ τι ῥέξαι ἀτάσθαλον ’nor to have done anything wanton’)
ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
